copy: The Nueva Andalucía Villa Collection is an exclusive set of just 8 villas, each interior-designed by a world-renowned Italian luxury fashion house, on expansive plots of approximately 2,000m² in the heart of Nueva Andalucía.

Each 5-bedroom, 6-bathroom villa spans around 1,100m² of total built area across three floors and a rooftop solarium, with a private pool, an indoor spa pool and gym, and gated, 24-hour secured grounds.

why.copy: The Nueva Andalucía Villa Collection suits buyers seeking a rare, ultra-boutique villa address minutes from Puerto Banús, with a design pedigree few developments can match.
points: Buyers who want an ultra-exclusive, design-led villa on a substantial private plot, in a collection of just 8 rather than a large development.
Every villa is interior-designed by a world-renowned Italian luxury fashion house, with a private pool, indoor spa pool, gym and rooftop solarium.
Set in Nueva Andalucía, minutes from Puerto Banús, the Golf Valley and Marbella's old town.
6 of the 8 villas remain; Nueva Living reconfirms live pricing and terms before any viewing.

copy: Each villa is arranged across a ground, first and second floor plus a private rooftop solarium, with a total built area of around 1,100m² on a plot of approximately 2,000m², including a private pool, covered and uncovered terraces and landscaped gardens.

Interiors are designed throughout by a world-renowned Italian luxury fashion house, from the finest marble and mosaics to bespoke furnishings, making each villa a fully realised, turnkey work of design.
highlights: Private pool, indoor spa pool and dedicated gym within each villa.
Rooftop solarium with a private plunge pool and panoramic views.
Gated entrance with 24-hour security and concierge services.

residences.copy: Every villa in the collection shares the same 5-bedroom, 6-bathroom layout across three floors and a rooftop solarium, with individual pricing set by plot position and finish.
